comments.author: @NICEGLOBE05
comments.text: Lesotho is a geographical wonder—the only independent state in the world lying entirely above 1,000 meters! Bridging the chill of the highlands with such vibrant local music and community life proves that its real beauty isn't just the snow, but the warmth of its people. Truly one of Africa's most underrated gems.

comments.author: @GlobeDiscovery-NY
comments.text: Lesotho is literally the only country in the world where every single point of its land is over 1,400 meters above sea level. Places like Afriski in the Maluti Mountains are operating right now for the winter season, which always catches people off guard when they think of African geography
